input.message:
Dear Landlord,

Re: Flat 6, 56 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ1 0ZZ – ref R/PM024-1 (oven not heating)

The tenant has reported that the oven is not heating properly: food such as chips or nuggets is still uncooked after 1.5 hours. We sent them the oven manual and suggested settings, but they have tried these and report the oven has not worked properly since they moved in.

Proposed next step: send an appliance engineer to inspect and diagnose the fault. We do not yet have a cost. If a repair or part is needed, we will ask the engineer for a quote and come back to you before any further work goes ahead.

Please reply APPROVE for us to arrange an engineer to inspect, or DECLINE if you would prefer otherwise. If you have a preferred engineer, please tell us who to use.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team, Northbridge Lettings

input.body:
Hello,

Thank you for letting us know that the oven is still not heating properly, even with the suggested settings. We are sorry for the inconvenience.

We have asked your landlord to approve sending an engineer to inspect the oven. We will update you within 2 working days, or sooner once we hear back. Once an engineer is arranged, they will contact you to agree a time.

In the meantime, please don't leave the oven running unattended for long periods, and switch it off at the wall if you notice any burning smell, sparking or tripping electrics, then let us know straight away.

Kind regards,
Donna
Maintenance team, Northbridge Lettings
Flat 6, 56 Juniper Mews, Northbridge, ZZ1 0ZZ – ref R/PM024-1
